Line 3 (Map Arsip Ordner) allows only 3 in one receipt. No earlier invoices on PO-2026-0141.

**Diagnosis:** The only goods receipt (GR-2026-0141) shows 3 dozen received; no earlier invoice has billed any PO-2026-0141 goods. The invoice bills 5 — 2 more than ever received. This is a short delivery: the vendor billed the full 5 ordered against a 3-unit receipt.
